hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Monotonic Runs
hints.text: Precompute left[i] (longest sorted streak ending at i) and right[i] (longest sorted streak starting at i).

hints.title: Bridge Condition
hints.text: Replacing element at index i can stitch left[i-1] and right[i+1] together whenever nums[i-1] <= nums[i+1].

hints.title: Boundary Extensions
hints.text: Even if nums[i-1] > nums[i+1], replacing nums[i] can still extend left[i-1] by 1 or right[i+1] by 1.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Two pass prefix/suffix run length arrays followed by linear stitch scan.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every modification and scanning array takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for left and right run arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bidirectional prefix and suffix streaks to evaluate single replacement bridges in linear time.
